thesis.core: 2026H1 confirms that the share-price trend is supported by real operating improvement: fleet deployment, higher special-shipping utilization/rates, stronger export volumes and margin expansion are translating into earnings and cash flow. The improvement is not purely expectations-driven.
thesis.variant_wedge: The market appears to have recognized most of the near-term earnings step-up. At the latest complete close, normalized risk/reward is no longer compelling enough for D2 promotion despite strong fundamentals.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use RMB2.35bn attributable net profit as base normalized earnings, close to trailing-twelve-month earnings of about RMB2.33bn (2025 full year less 2025H1 plus 2026H1), rather than annualizing 2026H1 RMB1.37bn to RMB2.74bn. This retains structural fleet/margin gains while hair-cutting unusually strong auto-export/tight-capacity conditions.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: TTM anchors current run-rate while avoiding full H1 annualization through a cyclical peak.

catalysts: New multipurpose/pulp and auto-carrier capacity continues converting into revenue without margin dilution.
Special-shipping TCE stays above the 2025 run-rate and high-value equipment/auto exports remain resilient.
Semi-submersible/offshore-wind project pipeline exits the current project-window softness.
Fleet expansion is funded without material deterioration in balance-sheet quality or cash conversion.
kill_thesis: Normalized attributable earnings fall below roughly RMB2.0bn without a temporary explanation.
Fleet TCE and gross margin decline together while leased-capacity costs remain elevated.
Auto-export or high-value equipment demand normalizes faster than new fleet capacity can be absorbed.
Operating cash flow materially decouples from reported profit for a sustained period.
At prices materially above base value without commensurate earnings upgrades, valuation itself remains a rejection gate.

d2_answers.question: Determine whether trend persistence is supported by durable fundamental change rather than expectations alone.
d2_answers.fact: 2026H1 revenue was RMB14.446bn (+34.07%), attributable net profit RMB1.371bn (+66.24%), recurring attributable net profit RMB1.338bn (+60.22%), and operating cash flow RMB3.752bn (+42.78%). Shipping-business gross margin rose 3.26ppt to 23.48%; total fleet TCE rose 9.40%. Auto-carrier revenue rose 98.50% with 34.10% gross margin, while new multipurpose revenue rose 49.62%.
d2_answers.interpretation: The trend has a genuine earnings/cash-flow foundation and reflects deployed capacity plus stronger mix, not only multiple expansion. However, auto export/tight ship supply and export revenue growth (+66.86%) amplify the cycle.

d2_answers.question: Test whether the expected return remains attractive after normalizing current momentum.
d2_answers.fact: The latest complete close was RMB11.67, with quoted TTM P/E about 13.76x. Approximate TTM attributable earnings are RMB2.326bn.
d2_answers.assumption: A 12-month probability-weighted valuation uses 10x/14x/17x P/E on RMB2.0bn/RMB2.35bn/RMB2.7bn normalized earnings with 25%/50%/25% probabilities.
d2_answers.interpretation: Probability-weighted value is about RMB12.00/share, only ~2.8% above the latest close before dividends. Even adding a dividend similar to the 2025 distribution would not meet a normal 15% new-capital hurdle.

d2_answers.question: Normalize earnings and cash flow using the latest primary financial disclosures.
d2_answers.fact: 2025 attributable net profit was RMB1.780bn and operating cash flow RMB6.339bn. 2026H1 attributable net profit was RMB1.371bn and operating cash flow RMB3.752bn. 2026H1 growth is broad-based, but auto-carrier and export transport are unusually strong and semi-submersible spot demand remains uneven.
d2_answers.interpretation: Base normalized earnings of RMB2.35bn are more defensible than either the 2025 level or a simple RMB2.74bn H1 annualization.

d2_answers.question: Build an explicit valuation range and identify what expectations are embedded in the current price.
d2_answers.fact: At RMB11.67 and about 2.744bn shares, equity value is roughly RMB32.0bn.
d2_answers.assumption: Bear/base/bull values are RMB7.29/RMB11.99/RMB16.73 per share.
d2_answers.interpretation: Current price is approximately the base-case value, implying the market already assumes a large portion of the fleet/mix earnings improvement persists. Upside requires sustained near-peak utilization/rates or a further structural earnings step-up.

d2_answers.question: Define the first-rejection test and the evidence that would invalidate the thesis.
d2_answers.judgment: The fundamental half of the first-rejection test is NOT triggered; the valuation half IS triggered for promotion. Retain research HOLD unless price falls toward roughly RMB10.4 or normalized earnings rise enough to restore >=15% expected return. Thesis invalidates on simultaneous TCE/margin deterioration, sub-RMB2.0bn normalized earnings, or sustained cash-conversion deterioration.
